tasks.instruction: Implement rank_versions(versions) in versions.py to sort version strings. Each version is a string of dot-separated non-negative integers like "1.10.2". Compare part by part as integers (so "1.10" is newer than "1.9") and return a new list ordered newest first (descending). Missing trailing parts count as 0, so "1.2" and "1.2.0" are equal versions. Equal versions are ordered by their string, in the same direction. Raise ValueError for an empty string or any non-numeric part. Save versions.py.

Fix timeparse.py: parse_duration(text) must convert a duration text to a number. A duration is one or more parts written as a non-negative integer followed by a unit: d (days), h (hours), m (minutes), s (seconds), for example "1d2h" or "90m15s". Return the total number of seconds as an int. The text must not contain spaces; raise ValueError if it does. The units must appear from largest to smallest and each at most once. Raise ValueError for an empty text, a missing number, an unknown unit, a repeated unit or units in the wrong order. Write the result to timeparse.py.

Implement rotate(grid, turns) in grid.py to rotate a grid clockwise. The grid is a list of rows (lists) of equal length. Rotate it by 90 degrees clockwise, turns times; turns is any integer, negative turns rotate the other way and only turns modulo 4 matters. Return a new list of lists and do not modify the input. An empty grid ([]) or a grid of empty rows is returned unchanged as a new list. Raise ValueError if the rows have different lengths. Save grid.py.
